long_biography.plain_text:
Shahid "Shad" Khan moved from Lahore to Illinois as a teenager to study industrial engineering. At automotive-parts manufacturer Flex-N-Gate, he developed a one-piece truck bumper designed to resist corrosion. He founded Bumper Works to manufacture it and in 1980 bought Flex-N-Gate from his former employer, turning a product idea into an international supplier.

Sport and entertainment became a second chapter. Khan acquired the Jacksonville Jaguars in 2012 and later bought Fulham F.C. in London. Through his son Tony, the family also backs All Elite Wrestling. The same pattern runs through both sides of his career: identify an overlooked opportunity, retain control and build patiently around a distinctive product or organisation.
